def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # ensure numeric types (handles text numbers like "-195", "4675")
    for c in ["bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", "year"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    # species: strip extra spaces and fix typo variant
    if "species" in df.columns:
        df["species"] = df["species"].astype("string").str.strip()
        df["species"] = df["species"].replace({"Chinstarp": "Chinstrap"})
    # flipper_length_mm: negatives are data entry errors, take absolute value
    if "flipper_length_mm" in df.columns:
        df["flipper_length_mm"] = df["flipper_length_mm"].abs()
    # body_mass_g: allowed 2500-6500, max 3500000 indicates extra zeros (mg vs g)
    if "body_mass_g" in df.columns:
        mask = df["body_mass_g"] > 6500
        df.loc[mask, "body_mass_g"] = df.loc[mask, "body_mass_g"] / 1000
    # island has no variants, sex missing means unknown - do not impute
    # drop exact duplicate rows (keep id column)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # drop missing group keys
    df = df.dropna(subset=["island"])
    # count penguins per island
    s = df.groupby("island").size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in s.items()}
